subject: Admin activity exports — SOC2 evidence & rolling snapshots
messages:
From: Jamie Lin <audit_team@brightcompliance.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: admin activity logs & preferred export formats for SOC 2 evidence

Hi Diego,

We're preparing the SOC 2 Type II evidence package for BrightCare and need your team's help with admin activity logs. Specifically:

- What admin activities are recorded (user/role changes, API key actions, model deployments, console logins, etc.)?
- Native retention period for those events and whether we support custom retention per-account.
- Supported export formats (JSONL, CSV, syslog, streaming to S3).
- A recommended cadence and a sample export file for verification (we'll checksum it).

If you can point us to a short runbook or export command and attach a small sample snapshot, that would be ideal. We may need one-time ad-hoc exports plus a weekly rolling snapshot for the audit window.

Thanks — can you get back to us by EOD Wednesday?

Jamie Lin
Senior Auditor, BrightCompliance
jamie.lin@brightcompliance.com

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Lin <audit_team@brightcompliance.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity logs & preferred export formats for SOC 2 evidence

Hi Jamie — thanks for the clear list. Summary below plus a small sample attached (admin_activity_snapshot_sample.jsonl).

What we log (admin activity):
- account_admin.login: web console & SSO (IP, user_id, method, success/fail)
- api_key.create / api_key.revoke: key id, actor, timestamp, reason
- role.assign / role.revoke: actor, target_user, role_name, timestamp
- config.change: resource (e.g., model routing, autoscale), prev/new values, actor, timestamp
- model.deploy / model.rollback: model_id, version, actor, deployment_id, timestamp
- data_access.grant / data_access.revoke: dataset_id, actor, scope, timestamp
- acl.change and network.policy.change (VPC/cidr updates)

Retention and retention controls:
- Default retention: 365 days for admin_activity events.
- Accounts on Dedicated/Private can request extended retention (up to 7 years) — this is a configured policy per-account and requires a support ticket and storage commitment.
- Short-term hot window: last 30 days are stored in hot indexes for fast queries; older data is archived to compressed snapshots.

Export formats / delivery options we support:
- JSONL (newline-delimited JSON) with canonical event schema (recommended for audits). Sample attached.
- Compressed CSV (for spreadsheet reviewers).
- S3 upload: automated weekly snapshots to a customer-provided S3 bucket (supports presigned-put or role-based delivery).
- Syslog/CEF streaming for SIEM integration (near real-time).
- API endpoint: POST /admin-exports/start with selectors for time range + event types, returns job id and presigned download on completion.

Checksum / verification: we include SHA256 of the compressed archive in the job metadata and a signed delivery manifest.

Operational cadence recommendation for SOC 2 evidence:
- One-time bulk export covering the audit window (we can provide incremental slices if the window is large).
- Weekly rolling snapshots (keeps consistent checkpoints).
- Retain snapshots for the audit retention period (for BrightCare we'll follow your requested retention; default 365 days unless you opt-in for extended).

Attached: admin_activity_snapshot_sample.jsonl (small, redacted), plus I uploaded the export playbook to our internal drive (link below).

Next steps: Monica (cc'd) will share the CLI/Api runbook and a sample presigned S3 command. Kimberly — looping you in on retention exceptions and paperwork if BrightCare wants extended retention.

Diego Fernandez
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
(attachment: admin_activity_snapshot_sample.jsonl - 1.9MB)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Lin <audit_team@brightcompliance.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity logs & preferred export formats for SOC 2 evidence

Hi Jamie — adding technical details and the exact commands we use. The attached export_playbook_v1.pdf has screenshots and schema but here's the quick runbook and the schema summary.

Quick CLI run (one-off export):
1) Create job for range:
   curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin-exports" \n     -H "Authorization: Bearer <svc-account-token>" \n     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n     -d '{"start_time":"2026-10-01T00:00:00Z","end_time":"2026-11-01T00:00:00Z","format":"jsonl","compress":true,"delivery":{"type":"s3","bucket":"brightcare-audit-uploads","path":"2026-10/"}}'

2) Poll job status: GET /v1/admin-exports/<job_id> — job returns presigned s3 url once ready.

S3 delivery options supported:
- presigned PUT (customer uploads)
- service role-based push (recommended for automated weekly snapshots)
- HTTPS download of compressed artifact (for one-offs)

Sample S3 presigned command (example only):
   aws s3 cp redwood_admin_activity_snapshot_20261109.jsonl.gz s3://brightcare-audit-uploads/2026-11-09/ --acl private --profile redwood-audit

Event schema (top-level fields):
- event_id, timestamp, event_type, actor {user_id, principal_type}, target {resource_type, resource_id}, ip_address, auth_method, details (free-form string), request_id, region, hashed_user_id (sha256)

Anonymization/pseudonymization options: we can hash user identifiers (sha256) at export time (deterministic) or redact them entirely. For BrightCare's SOC 2, we usually provide hashed_user_id + mapping under separate NDA if needed.

Retention enforcement:
- Policy enforced by policy engine; on-policy delete operations are logged and include a retention-change merchant event (retention.policy.update).
- Deletions produce audit markers and a deletion_manifest.gz for evidence.

Attachments: export_playbook_v1.pdf (runbook, CLI examples, job lifecycle diagram). I've also staged a sample full snapshot in the S3 path: s3://redwood-audit-exports/brightcare/20261109/redwood_admin_activity_snapshot_20261109.jsonl.gz (we'll exchange presigned URL when you confirm destination).

(attachment: export_playbook_v1.pdf - 0.7MB)

Regards,
Monica Patel
Engineering, Observability & Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Jamie Lin <audit_team@brightcompliance.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity logs & preferred export formats for SOC 2 evidence

Diego / Monica — this is exactly what we needed, thanks. A couple quick follow-ups:

1) For the weekly rolling snapshots, can you automate a cron job on your side to push to our S3 bucket (preferred) and provide presigned GET links each week?
2) For the hashed_user_id option — we'll request deterministic hashing with a per-audit salt. Can you confirm you can apply a salt we provide at export time (not stored on Redwood)?
3) Please include the SHA256 digest and signed manifest for each archive.

If you can confirm items 1–3 and share the presigned link for the sample snapshot by EOD today, we'll mark this as provided in the evidence tracker and move on to the control testing schedule.

Thanks,
Jamie
